## E — Market signal: safe vehicle operation part one (lanes, passing, turning, speed, weather, night, impaired, distracted and aggressive driving, rural roads and interstates)
Market research was not performed in this state worker pass and no CompetitiveIntel artifact was supplied, so the market pack for this topic is typed debt (IN-SAFEONE-MARKET).
Open items: applicant volume, pass rates, seasonality, buyer persona, price expectations, verbatim voice-of-customer quotes, ad hooks and the named gap.
Manual-only observation, not market evidence: the speed limits by road type and the low-beam distances are the kind of number lists learners drill, which suggests a numbers drill angle to test later.
No market figures are asserted; every figure waits for a sourced recon pass.

corpus_stability.reason: The Indiana Driver's Manual back cover reads Published July 2026 and tells readers to check IN.gov/BMV for updates; the BMV manual page says printed manuals are updated at most once a year, so the selected pages are treated as stable within a year while fees and service details stay dynamic.
